note: R-192. `state-covenant` carries a fixture-wide `"compilers": ["go"]` allowlist, justified by two Go-only builtins (bbFieldMul, merkleRootSha256). But the allowlist is FIXTURE-wide, so the covenant's state-continuation lowering, its OP_CODESEPARATOR handling and its output construction were excused from cross-tier parity too — mechanics that have nothing to do with the STARK families. This is the same contract with the two builtin calls removed, as a full seven-tier fixture, so the mechanics are checked and only the two builtins stay isolated.
